answer: Each name is charged £22 per docket, and 300 dockets before the first reward is released, and the charges stack up faster than the rewards do. Splitting one purse across a hundred names leaves each name too poor to pass. Cheap to join once, ruinous to join a hundred times — that is the point. The desk only stamps a name that carries Claybound terracotta tilework dealer raku patent, and the stamp itself rests on a patent terracotta tilework dealers file after tilework office reviews. The clerk notes relic. The forge is checked, not assumed. The tally keeps pearl.
